# M5 MPIIFaceGaze leave-one-person-out summary (generated by `make eval-lopo`; do not edit by hand)

- 15 participants, 37667 frames; 5 k-shot seeds; runtime 448 s.
- Errors: Euclidean on the screen plane, mean over each person's evaluated frames, then mean ± sd over people. `my px` = the mean converted to CSS px on the user's display (301.2 mm = 1512 px), comparable with live σ_px (which is an RMS, so typically larger than a mean for the same errors).
- Calibration frames are never evaluated (asserted in code and tested).
